hands.name: Flush Five
lines: 5 cards with the same rank and suit

hands.name: Flush House
lines: A Three of a Kind and a Pair with
all cards sharing the same suit

hands.name: Straight Flush
lines: 5 cards in a row (consecutive ranks) with
all cards sharing the same suit

hands.name: Four of a Kind
lines: 4 cards with the same rank. They may
be played with 1 other unscored card

hands.name: Full House
lines: A Three of a Kind and a Pair

hands.name: Flush
lines: 5 cards that share the same suit

hands.name: Three of a Kind
lines: 3 cards with the same rank. They may be
played with up to 2 other unscored cards

hands.name: Two Pair
lines: 2 pairs of cards with different ranks, may
be played with 1 other unscored card

hands.name: Pair
lines: 2 cards that share the same rank. They may
be played with up to 3 other unscored cards

hands.name: High Card
lines: If the played hand is not any of the above
hands, only the highest ranked card scores
